decisions.why: A named oncology reconstruction implant system (juvenile bone tumour resection), matching the Total Orthopaedic Solutions 3 'implant' type.
Onkos Surgical's 3D-printed oncology reconstruction implant range, matching the 'implant' type.
The Ilizarov circular external fixator, a named limb-reconstruction/trauma fixation device, matching the 'trauma' type (Trauma & fixation).
Conformis iTotal CR/PS is a named total knee replacement implant system, matching the 'implant' type.
A named Symbios hip implant system, consistent with Symbios's own site filing this product under 'Hanche' (Hip) and mapped to 'implant' there this same run.

Synicem (Biocomposites) is a bone-cement brand; 'Clous' (French: nails) names its antibiotic-loaded cement-coated intramedullary nail line for infected fractures — confirmed via Biocomposites' own product pages — so the product genuinely spans both bone cement and trauma/fixation.
Precice (Globus Medical / NuVasive Specialized Orthopedics) is a named intramedullary limb-lengthening nail system for trauma/reconstruction, matching the 'trauma' type.
